notes: Exact-version rules reviewed against native run 38698509912 and primary browser sources. Rejections require correlated real CTAP command/status evidence and healthy controls. Generic browser errors and timeouts remain failures.

rejection_rules.rationale: The make_credential bridge filters unsupported PublicKeyCredentialParameters identifiers. With only these unknown IDs, the real key receives no supported algorithm and responds CTAP2_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ALGORITHM (0x26). Require that exact response, successful surrounding commands and a prompt non-timeout browser error.

ES256K is offered and makeCredential succeeds, but Curve::try_from cannot represent secp256k1 (COSE curve 8), so Firefox rejects the response. Require the real successful makeCredential response, no other CTAP errors and prompt browser rejection.
